title: Credential-free capable-endpoint capability ladder and hosted-provisioning census under the frozen minimal multi-step Web-agent protocol, with a conditional external-comparator readiness table (readiness condition / blocker B3 for the gated four-arm benchmark).
question: Which hosted/capable model class (or alternative credential-free path) can clear the minimal multi-step Web-agent bar required by readiness condition (3) (blocker B3) of the gated four-arm benchmark COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER - given that the credential-free local 3B-8B Qwen class failed even under the goal/schema prompt (EXP-INTEL-38164607941, FALSIFIES, audit PASS) - and, if no capable same-protocol endpoint can be provisioned, what is the exact credential/operational blocker? Refinement into the smallest rigorous falsifiable probe: (A) a credential-free capability ladder over model classes NOT previously tested (a larger same-family local class and a different-family local class) measured by the byte-frozen minimal protocol with the frozen P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA prompt and frozen GBNF constrained decoding; (B) a bounded hosted-provisioning census that records, per predeclared provider, whether a same-protocol endpoint is provisionable and if not the exact credential/operational blocker; (C) a conditional, non-gating external-comparator readiness table enumerating the strongest externally published inheritance/memory systems (QCR arXiv:2608.12847, compile-and-execute arXiv:2604.09718, site-memory/ColorBrowserAgent) as CANDIDATE_NOT_EVIDENCE whose numbers and denominators must be reproduced before use.
hypothesis: H1 (capability). At least one predeclared credential-free candidate class not previously tested - M-14B-QWEN (Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct Q4_K_M, scale beyond the tested 8B ceiling) or M-8B-LLAMA (Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct Q4_K_M, non-Qwen family) - clears the inherited capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the 5 frozen seeded episodes) under the frozen minimal protocol and the frozen goal/schema system prompt, thereby satisfying readiness condition (3) at mechanism level with a factory-provisionable credential-free local endpoint. H2 (provisioning). No hosted same-protocol model endpoint is provisionable in this factory without a human-issued credential: every predeclared hosted provider is either credential-gated (exact missing environment variable recorded) or unreachable, and the only reachable credential-free hosted path (Pollinations gpt-oss-20b) is operationally capped (reasoning-only content, small completion-token cap, intermittent HTTP 402, no model pinning/SLA).
falsifier: H0 (bounded negative). No predeclared credential-free candidate clears the bar - every COMPLETE candidate cell has task_success_rate < 0.6 - AND the census finds no PROVISIONABLE_CREDENTIATED hosted provider, so no currently-provisionable same-protocol endpoint (credential-free local or hosted) can drive the minimal multi-step Web-agent test and readiness condition (3) is NOT_SATISFIED; the gated four-arm benchmark must be re-scoped (drop the same-model external published-baseline anchor in favour of internally re-run comparators on a dynamic-range task bank, or obtain a hosted credential, or pursue a different model class). FALSIFIES is asserted only over the COMPLETE, predeclared credential-free local candidate set (and is a capability bound on those tested classes/quantisation, not a global rejection of C-LLM-INHERIT and not a closure of hosted frontier classes, which remain UNRESOLVED-by-blocker). A candidate whose GGUF fails to load or whose treatment PC gate fails is recorded as UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED / UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED and is NOT counted as a capability failure; if no candidate is COMPLETE the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not a scientific negative.

baselines.description: Protocol-hardness anchor, NOT re-run. Under the byte-identical frozen minimal protocol and the goal/schema prompt (P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, string sha256 36a4240aba96e46797c16aebbedcc548778a0c1097b4ce4432608148758c5716), both credential-free Qwen2.5 3B-8B Q4_K_M candidates failed the bar: M-7B-QWEN task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5), zero answer actions; M-3B-QWEN task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5). This establishes that the frozen protocol is hard for the tested class (the bar is not trivially met) while constrained decoding is live.
baselines.expected_outcome: FAIL (carried reference; not re-run). Used only to certify protocol hardness and decoding liveness; it is not a comparator arm for the new candidates.

baselines.description: Uniform random action selection from the frozen 5-action space (click #reveal-btn; answer TARGET-41; answer TARGET-42; answer TARGET-43; answer unknown), 5 episodes, seeded random.Random(42) created once and reused (as the frozen runner's make_random_producer does), run against the SERVED task page through the same frozen run_episode scorer as the candidates. The parent's null-random mode ran on about:blank (a navigation defect); this design runs every mechanical control against the served page.
baselines.expected_outcome: parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (valid JSON by construction) and task_success_rate<0.6. Analytic per-episode success probability = sum_{j=1..4}(1/5)^(j+1) = 0.04992, so P(task_success_rate>=3/5)=P(Binomial(5,0.04992)>=3)~1.15e-3 and the 0.6 bar is effectively unreachable by chance. task_success_rate>=0.6 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baselines.description: Credential-free hosted path, NOT re-run. Pollinations anonymous proxy (https://text.pollinations.ai/openai; GET /models resolves openai-fast -> gpt-oss-20b, tier anonymous, reasoning=true, tools=true). Under the same minimal Web-agent task the grandparent recorded: empty content with reasoning-only output and a ~197 completion-token cap despite max_tokens=1200, 1 step, 197 tokens; intermittent HTTP 402; no model pinning/SLA. Recorded in the census as CREDENTIAL_FREE_OPERATIONALLY_CAPPED with the exact operational blocker.
baselines.expected_outcome: FAIL (carried reference; not re-run). Establishes the exact operational blocker for the only reachable credential-free hosted path.

positive_control.success_criterion: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 per evaluated candidate cell; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 at preflight

members.protocol: 10 probes per evaluated candidate of the frozen probe string emitted by the frozen base config prompts.positive_control_probe ('Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}') under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA with the frozen GBNF grammar (string sha256 16c9877c0829b2099bd7180c212f28d8c545b095e9a4411afa7cabccd3fa6a65). Executed by the frozen runner mode_probe_candidate.
members.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid JSON matching the action schema (positive_control_pass_rate=1.0)
members.failure_policy: a candidate whose PC gate fails is EXCLUDED (no episodes) and recorded UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED; it is not a capability failure.

members.protocol: 5 scripted episodes (click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42) driven through the REAL frozen run_episode scorer against the served page, with navigation repaired (page.goto before any episode). The scripted step producer returns json.dumps strings as required by the frozen parse_action contract.
members.success_criterion: 5/5 task_success=true (proves the scorer registers the full completion path and mechanical verification is live)
members.failure_policy: <5/5 -> preflight failure -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (scorer broken, not model behaviour).

null_control.protocol: 5 episodes of fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') through the real frozen scorer against the SERVED task page (navigated).
null_control.failure_policy: any parseable or successful episode -> verification logic broken -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID

measurement_validity: Frozen protocol identity: this packet reuses the audited frozen runner research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py (file sha256 2b5d5bb5da608adbcc68cc78120a88bc2b8809816e29f9d87d25c0c75bc25c00) and the frozen base fixture research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37982024058/raw/harness_config.json (file sha256 7aba9dc899c40dd29f87b4265835eea6dc0b889c66271a983e4b82b8f5bc7adb). Both are freeze_artifacts; EXECUTE must re-verify their hashes and fail closed on mismatch.

Substrate identity: the task is the frozen single-page MIN-WEBAGENT-CLICK-REVEAL-ANSWER fixture (#reveal-btn reveals #target=TARGET-42; the reveal button is hidden after the first click), max_steps_per_episode=5, threshold_target_text=TARGET-42; served on 127.0.0.1 via the frozen start_page_server, driven by Playwright + /usr/bin/google-chrome.

Single manipulated dimension across candidates: only the model GGUF (and the model-family chat_format required to load it) differs between candidate cells. The task page, user template, system prompt (P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, string sha256 36a4240aba96e46797c16aebbedcc548778a0c1097b4ce4432608148758c5716), GBNF grammar (string sha256 16c9877c0829b2099bd7180c212f28d8c545b095e9a4411afa7cabccd3fa6a65), sampling (temperature=0.0, max_tokens=512, n_ctx=2048, llama_seed=42, base_seed=42, episode seeds 42-46, n_threads=4), strict parse_action and the mechanical run_episode scorer are identical for every candidate.

Per-candidate config overlays are deterministic transformations of the frozen base config: load the base config bytes and replace ONLY prompts.system (with the frozen P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA string), sampling.chat_format (with the candidate's family chat format) and candidate_models_frozen (with the single candidate's frozen entry). Every other key is inherited byte-for-byte. The overlay is written to the exact path the frozen runner reads: <per-candidate-outdir>/raw/harness_config.json. EXECUTE records each overlay's sha256 in provenance.json and verifies the object-level diff is confined to those three keys.

Strict mechanical verification: Playwright DOM assertions plus whole-string JSON-schema parse identical to the frozen parse_action (the entire completion must be valid JSON matching {action: click|answer, selector?: string, text?: string} with the action-appropriate required field); task_success additionally requires the mechanical reveal (#target visible with text TARGET-42) AND a terminal answer action whose text equals TARGET-42. No LLM grading.

GGUF provisioning is fail-closed on digest: each candidate's downloaded file must match the pinned sha256 and byte count; a mismatch or a load failure marks that candidate UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED (operational, not a capability failure) and the ladder continues; it never enters the capability bar as a failure.
The P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA prompt leaks neither '#reveal-btn' nor 'TARGET-42' (design-time verified), so a treatment success cannot be attributed to answer leakage.

Deterministic protocol: temperature=0.0 + fixed seeds. Under the frozen adequacy rule (5 episodes, 3/5 = 0.6 exactly) there is no variance estimate; 0.6 is a pre-declared capability-gate adequacy rule, not a statistical threshold. This limitation is inherited and disclosed.

Representation loss (inherited): state is a simplified text observation (PAGE_TEXT 300 chars, ELEMENTS over button/a/input, HISTORY), not a full accessibility tree. After the reveal, PAGE_TEXT contains TARGET-42 and ELEMENTS lists the (now hidden) reveal button; the tested class re-clicks it rather than answering. This packet changes only the model class, not the observation representation.

The endpoint census is observational (env-var presence + unauthenticated HTTP status/reachability + carried receipts). It is not outcome-bearing and is non-gating for the capability OUTCOME; it exists to answer the mandate's 'exact credential/operational blocker' clause. Hosted model numbers are CANDIDATE_NOT_EVIDENCE.

The external-comparator readiness table is a literature-identity enumeration (pinned arXiv IDs/titles/dates, reported metric, denominator, reproduction prerequisites), explicitly labelled CANDIDATE_NOT_EVIDENCE and non-gating. No external vendor number is used as SPIDER evidence.

Scope bound: FALSIFIES is bounded to the predeclared credential-free local Q4_K_M classes tested (Qwen2.5-14B, Llama-3.1-8B) plus the carried Qwen 3B-8B anchors and the recorded non-provisionable hosted census. It does not close hosted frontier classes (blocked, not tested), other quantisations, other tasks, or other domains, and it does not globally reject C-LLM-INHERIT.
decision_rule: OUTCOME is exactly one of {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}. B3_STATUS is a separate derived field in {SATISFIED, NOT_SATISFIED, UNRESOLVED}. DEFINITIONS: a CELL(c) is one predeclared candidate c measured by the frozen runner research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py (mode probe-candidate) with its per-candidate config overlay = a PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING gate (10 probes) followed by an episode batch (clearing_threshold.episodes=5). CELL(c) is COMPLETE iff load_status==LOADED AND positive_control_pass_rate==1.0 AND exactly 5 episode records; EXCLUDED iff LOADED and the PC gate did not pass (no episodes); UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED iff the GGUF digest mismatched or the model failed to load; PARTIAL iff the PC gate passed but fewer than 5 episode records. CLEARS(c) iff COMPLETE and task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6. PRECEDENCE (first matching rule wins): (1) PREFLIGHT, executed once before the ladder: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE==5/5 AND NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION==(parseable 0.0, task_success 0.0) AND B-RANDOM-ACTION==(parseable 1.0, task_success_rate<0.6) AND all freeze_artifact hash checks match AND required stack imports succeed; else OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, B3_STATUS=UNRESOLVED, STOP. (2) ENDPOINT CENSUS, executed independently and non-gating: for each predeclared provider record credential_env, credential_present, unauthenticated reachability_http_status, classification in {PROVISIONABLE_CREDENTIATED, CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED, CREDENTIAL_FREE_OPERATIONALLY_CAPPED, UNREACHABLE} and blocker (exact missing env var / HTTP status / operational cap). (3) CAPABILITY LADDER over [M-14B-QWEN, M-8B-LLAMA] in order; for each candidate c: (3a) verify the pinned GGUF sha256+bytes (mismatch -> UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED, continue); (3b) load (failure -> UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED, continue); (3c) run the PC gate then the 5 episodes; if EXCLUDED -> UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED, continue; if PARTIAL -> record and continue; (3d) if COMPLETE and CLEARS -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS, B3_STATUS=SATISFIED, STOP (early stop on the first clearing candidate); (3e) if COMPLETE and not CLEARS -> TREATMENT_FAILS_BAR, continue. (4) AFTER THE LADDER, if no candidate CLEARED: if no candidate is COMPLETE -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, B3_STATUS=UNRESOLVED, STOP; else OUTCOME=FALSIFIES and B3_STATUS = NOT_SATISFIED if every predeclared hosted provider is CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED/UNREACHABLE/CREDENTIAL_FREE_OPERATIONALLY_CAPPED, else UNRESOLVED (a credentialed hosted provider is provisionable, so a hosted capability test remains the smallest next action). CANONICAL PACKET MAPPING: SUPPORTS -> result.outcome=SUPPORTS, result.status=COMPLETE; FALSIFIES -> result.outcome=FALSIFIES, result.status=COMPLETE; MEASUREMENT_INVALID -> result.status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, result.outcome=INCONCLUSIVE. B3_STATUS and the census/blocker records are written in result.metrics and result.observations; they do not override the frozen OUTCOME.
product_consequence_positive: If a predeclared credential-free candidate CLEARS the bar (OUTCOME=SUPPORTS): readiness condition (3) / blocker B3 is satisfiable with a factory-provisionable credential-free local endpoint (the clearing candidate's GGUF + llama.cpp). The gated four-arm benchmark COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER (same model/tools/budget) becomes executable at that model class with the verified goal/schema prompt, subject to B1 (shipped carrier) and B2 (non-ceiling dynamic-range task bank), which are owned by Product and Runtime and are parallel to, not dependent on, B3. Whether C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL remains a DIRECTOR adjudication. The external-comparator readiness table bounds the fair comparator set for the benchmark.
product_consequence_negative: If no predeclared credential-free candidate CLEARS and no hosted provider is provisionable (OUTCOME=FALSIFIES, B3_STATUS=NOT_SATISFIED): the minimal multi-step Web-agent bar is not cleared by any credential-free Q4_K_M local class tested up to 14B and a non-Qwen 8B family, and the only reachable credential-free hosted path is operationally capped; readiness condition (3) is NOT_SATISFIED. The recorded exact blocker per hosted provider (missing credential environment variable or unreachable endpoint) and the census classification become decision inputs for the Global Research Director, who owns the re-scope choice: obtain a hosted credential (pinning/SLA), or drop Gate 3's same-model external published-baseline anchor in favour of internally re-run comparators on a task bank with a dynamic-range certificate, or provision a different model class. This packet does not pre-decide the re-scope. A MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome changes no claim and requires the recorded repair before any re-run.
estimated_cost: CPU-only (nproc=4, 15 GB RAM, ~14 GB available, 85 GB free disk; design-time probe: Python 3.12.15, /usr/bin/google-chrome present; llama_cpp/playwright/openai NOT preinstalled -> EXECUTE installs). Downloads (design-time HTTP 200, digest-pinned): M-14B-QWEN 8,988,110,976 bytes + M-8B-LLAMA 4,920,739,232 bytes = ~13.9 GB worst case (early stop after the first clearing candidate may avoid the second download). llama-cpp-python build (sdist) ~5-15 min. Inference: frozen runner runs 10 PC probes + up to 5 episodes x up to 5 steps per candidate; at the parent's measured 6.22 s/call for 7B (2.73 s/call for 3B), scaling to ~10-12 s/call for 14B gives ~5-15 min per candidate. Endpoint census <5 min. No external API spend (no credential exists; census is unauthenticated reachability only). Wall-clock estimate 60-180 min.
expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in both directions. Positive: a credential-free capable class is found, B3 is cleared, and the flagship four-arm benchmark can proceed at that class. Negative: the credential-free Q4_K_M local path is bounded at the tested classes, the exact hosted-credential blocker is recorded per provider, B3 is explicitly NOT_SATISFIED, and the Director receives a concrete re-scope set plus a bounded external-comparator readiness table - so the four-arm benchmark is not funded on an unavailable anchor. It directly tests the parent handoff's declared unknown U-03 ('whether 14B+/non-Qwen GGUFs clear the bar') and the mandate's hosted-provisioning clause, and it does NOT re-run the spent 3B-8B prompt ablation or the spent Pollinations agent attempt.

candidates.note: Larger same-family class (scale beyond the tested 3B-8B ceiling). Single-file Q4_K_M; design-time HTTP 200 via huggingface.co resolve-redirect; sha256 equals the HF LFS OID (CDN etag). RAM risk: ~9.0 GB weights on a 15 GB box; a load failure is recorded UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED (operational, not a capability failure) and the ladder continues.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every branch is arithmetically reachable and no later rule is shadowed. SUPPORTS requires one COMPLETE candidate cell with task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6 (k>=3 of 5); the design-time canary proved the same frozen scorer registers the full click-then-answer completion (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5, each episode revealing TARGET-42 and answering it) and the GBNF admits the success path (strchar ::= [^\"\\] admits '-', digits and uppercase, so "selector":"#reveal-btn" and "text":"TARGET-42" are grammar-admissible), so a clearing candidate can be registered; the candidates' true outcomes are empirically open, which is the point of the ladder. FALSIFIES is reachable whenever at least one candidate cell is COMPLETE and none clears; the carried anchor shows the parent realized exactly this failure mode at 3B-8B, and neither new candidate is guaranteed to clear. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via preflight failure (rule 1) or no COMPLETE cell (rule 4). The threshold (0.6 over 5 episodes, k in 0..5, k>=3) is attainable at both ends; early stop at rule 3d cannot shadow FALSIFIES because when a candidate clears there is nothing left to falsify and when it does not the ladder continues; a load failure or PC failure is explicitly non-terminal (continue), so the FALSIFIES/UNRESOLVED branch is not emptied by operational failure.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is verified at DESIGN time or pinned fail-closed. (a) Stack (design-time probe): Python 3.12.15, nproc=4, 15 GB RAM / ~14 GB available, 85 GB free disk, /usr/bin/google-chrome present and driven by Playwright in the canary; llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 has a sdist and was built by the parent (no cp312 wheel), and playwright installs from PyPI without browser download when executable_path points at system Chrome. (b) Model provisioning (design-time HTTP): both candidate GGUFs return HTTP 200 via the huggingface.co resolve-redirect with pinned byte counts and sha256 equal to the HF LFS OID (M-14B-QWEN 8,988,110,976 / d989c91de35f32c18bdb8bec96a4b9fff2c3e5bca066503c63a5ca54dd537a4b; M-8B-LLAMA 4,920,739,232 / 854506123b68372492b8a99bb3a999594672b394791cf1153f8da5ffb5f1c59a); digest or load failure is recorded UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED and does not invalidate the packet. (c) GBNF grammar: all 7 rules (root, ws, action, field, string, strchars, strchar) are defined and referenced; string sha256 16c9877c0829b2099bd7180c212f28d8c545b095e9a4411afa7cabccd3fa6a65; the success path is grammar-admissible (no floor degeneracy). (d) The frozen runner and base fixture are bound freeze_artifacts previously executed end-to-end by the audited parent. (e) The scorer/controls liveness was re-verified at DESIGN time by a non-outcome-bearing canary (Appendix B) on the byte-identical frozen runner with a real browser and a name-only llama_cpp stub: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5, NC 0/0, B-RANDOM parseable 1.0 / success 0.2. (f) The endpoint census method was probed live at design time (OpenAI/Anthropic/Groq unauthenticated models endpoints returned HTTP 401; Pollinations /models returned HTTP 200), so the census is executable. No confirmatory model measurement was run during DESIGN.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The capability decision is against a pre-declared absolute bar (task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6), not against a within-run comparator, so there is no treatment/comparator identity problem. The measurement range is non-degenerate: the same frozen scorer registers 5/5 at the ceiling (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE) and the carried anchor produced 0/5 task success at the floor under the identical protocol, while the chance baseline is analytically confined below the bar (P(task_success_rate>=3/5)~1.15e-3). The manipulation across candidates is exactly the model weights (plus the family chat_format required to load them); task/prompt/grammar/sampling/parse/scorer are byte-inherited, so any difference in task_success_rate is attributable to the model class or to fail-closed infrastructure caught by preflight/digest checks. The carried anchor is byte-identified and not re-run; its role is descriptive protocol-hardness certification, so a carried-anchor drift cannot silently become a comparator.

control_sensitivity.reason: All controls are sensitive and were executed at DESIGN time as a non-outcome-bearing canary through the REAL frozen run_episode scorer with a REAL browser (Playwright + /usr/bin/google-chrome; name-only llama_cpp import stub; no model under test) against the served task page (Appendix B): PC-ORACLE-EPISODE fired 5/5 task_success (each episode revealed TARGET-42 and answered it, proving the completion path is registerable); NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION stayed 0/5 parseable and 0/5 success (rejects non-JSON); B-RANDOM-ACTION was parseable 1.0 and task_success_rate=0.2 with the 0.6 bar effectively unreachable by chance (analytic P(>=3/5)~1.15e-3). PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 was realized per model in the audited parent under the identical grammar and probe and is re-verified per candidate at EXECUTE. Distinct controls cover decoding, scoring, null rejection and chance-level success; none is tautological (none contains the target answer supplied to the model) and none is structurally impossible. A control failure yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a false capability result.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment arm (a new candidate under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA + frozen GBNF, driven by the frozen runner) is structurally live: the prompt enumerates exactly the two actions admitted by the frozen grammar using the grammar's required key names ('click' with 'selector', 'answer' with 'text'); the success path is grammar-admissible (strchar admits '#reveal-btn' and 'TARGET-42'); the same frozen scorer registered the full click-then-answer completion 5/5 in the design-time canary; and the carried parent cells show this task family reliably emits parseable matched actions under constrained decoding (10/10 PC; 5/5 step-1 parseable). Provisioning of both GGUFs is verified (URLs 200, digests pinned, fail-closed). Self-attack (recorded, not hidden): (i) the frozen GBNF does not by itself guarantee matched action/field pairs, so liveness rests on empirically verified decoding behaviour plus the rule that a below-0.6 step-1 parseable rate can never clear the bar; (ii) the 14B GGUF (~9.0 GB) may fail to load on a 15 GB box - that candidate is then UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED and the ladder continues, and the 8B Llama (~4.9 GB) is comfortably loadable, so at least one candidate is measurable; (iii) the 'llama-3' chat_format may be unsupported by the installed llama-cpp-python build - then M-8B-LLAMA is UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED, which is an operational record, not a capability failure, and M-14B-QWEN still yields a COMPLETE cell. The P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA prompt leaks neither '#reveal-btn' nor 'TARGET-42' (design-time verified), so a positive is not an answer-leakage artifact.
